text:
julia: Quick kickoff for the "Bento Launch" mini-workshop (May 12). Goal: test small starter prompts + tiny credit nudges to lift 7-day activation. Want 3 arms and a routing plan.

omar: Proposed arms:
- Control: post-event docs only
- Arm A: persona prompt pack (Product/Data/Infra)
- Arm B: persona pack + 40 starter credits + 48h in-app nudge
Hypothesis: B lifts first-success but check cost per activated user.

tess: Metrics to capture: registered, attended, prompt_pack_clicked, credits_issued, credits_redeemed, first_success_call, active_7d, tokens_first_week. Add cohort_id on every event.

julia: Landing UX: persona dropdown + checkbox "Claim starter credits". Routing rules: persona->nurture list; cohort_id and preferred_model in payload. If dedicated pool full, fallback to hosted.

omar: Webhook sample (to marketing/inbound):
```json
{"event":"bento_registered","email":"{{email}}","persona":"product","cohort_id":"bento-may12-b","preferred_model":"redwood-ded-1","fallback_model":"redwood-hosted-1","utm_campaign":"bento-may"}
```

tess: Add model_used to credits_redeemed so we can calc per-model cost. Also implement campaign cap: $8k; alert #finance at 75% and auto-stop at 100%.

julia: Copy hooks for social + landing hero: "Build an LLM demo in one session — starter prompts + credits for attendees". CTA variants: "Reserve spot", "Claim kit", "Get credits".

omar: UX experiment idea: show a small persistent header CTA "Use your starter credits" for 5 days vs none. Run on 25% of Arm B to limit spend.

tess: Tracking snippet for devs:
```js
analytics.track('bento_attended', {
  email: '{{email}}',
  cohort_id: 'bento-may12-b',
  persona: 'product'
});
```

analytics-bot: Event scheduled: bento-may12 created. Calendar invite posted to #marketing. Reminders: 48h, 2h, 15m.

julia: Owners & deadlines:
- Instrumentation + dashboard: tess (EOD Thu)
- Prompt packs: omar (EOD Wed)
- Copy + landing: julia (tomorrow noon)
- Ops: cap enforcement + webhook: infra (pinged)

omar: I'll include JS/Python quick-start snippets in each prompt pack and a tiny benchmark table (tokens/query before vs after).

tess: Dashboard should show funnels by cohort & persona and a cost tile (credits$ + est infra$/activated_user). I'll add cohort tagging schema.

julia: Great. Quick sync 9:30 tomorrow. Keep messages concise when posting deliverables. :rocket:
